---
title: "Exploring Citi Bike Usage Patterns Across Time and Space in New Jersey City"
output: html_document
---
 

![](images/homepage.gif)

New Jersey City is always moving and so do Citi Bikes! Citi Bikes plays a major role in sustainable transportation across New Jersey City. Understanding when, where, and how riders use Citi Bikes can provide valuable insights into commuter behavior, infrastructure needs, and seasonal ridership trends. Our goal is to uncover meaningful patterns in trip frequency, duration, and geography that can help shape the future bike-share infrastructure and sustainable transportation of New Jersey City.

## Overview of Citi Bikes in New Jersey City in 2023

```{r include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(readxl)
library(knitr)
library(patchwork)
library(ggridges)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(leaflet)
library(viridis)
library(scales)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r include=FALSE}

# First, let's check the files in our data directory
files <- list.files("data", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

cat("Found", length(files), "files in data directory:\n")
cat(paste(files, collapse = "\n"), "\n")

# Define column types based on Citi Bike data structure
col_types <- cols(
  ride_id = col_character(),
  rideable_type = col_character(),
  started_at = col_datetime(format = ""),
  ended_at = col_datetime(format = ""),
  start_station_name = col_character(),
  start_station_id = col_character(),
  end_station_name = col_character(),
  end_station_id = col_character(),
  start_lat = col_double(),
  start_lng = col_double(),
  end_lat = col_double(),
  end_lng = col_double(),
  member_casual = col_character()
)

# Import and combine all monthly data files
citibike_2023_raw <- files %>% 
  map_dfr(read_csv, 
          col_types = col_types,
          .id = "source_file")

# Clean variable names using janitor
citibike_2023 <- citibike_2023_raw %>%
  janitor::clean_names()

```

```{r include=FALSE}
# Create an initial cleaned dataset

citibike_2023_clean <- citibike_2023 %>%
  mutate(
    # ride length
    ride_length_min = as.numeric(difftime(ended_at, started_at, units = "mins")),
    
    # Date/time components
    start_date = as_date(started_at),
    start_hour = hour(started_at),
    start_month = month(started_at, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
    start_day = wday(started_at, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
    start_year = year(started_at),

    # time of day category
    time_of_day = case_when(
      start_hour >= 5 & start_hour < 12 ~ "Morning",
      start_hour >= 12 & start_hour < 17 ~ "Afternoon",
      start_hour >= 17 & start_hour < 21 ~ "Evening",
      TRUE ~ "Night"
    ),

    # bike type cleaned
    bike_type = case_when(
      rideable_type == "electric_bike" ~ "Electric",
      rideable_type == "classic_bike"  ~ "Classic",
      rideable_type == "docked_bike"   ~ "Docked",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),

    # weekend vs weekday
    day_type = ifelse(start_day %in% c("Saturday", "Sunday"), "Weekend", "Weekday")
  ) %>%
  # remove problematic/unrealistic rides
  filter(
    ride_length_min >= 1,
    ride_length_min <= 24 * 60,
    started_at < ended_at,
    !(start_station_id == end_station_id & ride_length_min < 2)
  )

cat("Created citibike_2023_clean with", format(nrow(citibike_2023_clean), big.mark=","), "rows\n")

```

```{r include=FALSE}

# Let's check what we actually filtered
cat("Original dataset size:", format(nrow(citibike_2023), big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("After 'NYC filtering':", format(nrow(citibike_2023_clean), big.mark = ","), "\n")

# Check longitude distribution to confirm NJ location
lng_summary <- citibike_2023_clean %>%
  summarise(
    min_start_lng = min(start_lng, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_start_lng = max(start_lng, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_start_lng = median(start_lng, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_west_of_74 = mean(start_lng < -74.00) * 100
  )

cat("Start Longitude Range:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Min: %.4f (Westernmost point)\n", lng_summary$min_start_lng))
cat(sprintf("  Max: %.4f (Easternmost point)\n", lng_summary$max_start_lng))
cat(sprintf("  Median: %.4f\n", lng_summary$median_start_lng))
cat(sprintf("  Percentage west of -74.00: %.1f%% (typical NJ boundary)\n", lng_summary$pct_west_of_74))

```

```{r include=FALSE}
# We created citibike_2023_clean in previous code

# Let's check what variables already exist
cat("\nChecking existing variables in citibike_2023_clean:\n")
cat("ride_length_min exists:", "ride_length_min" %in% names(citibike_2023_clean), "\n")
cat("start_date exists:", "start_date" %in% names(citibike_2023_clean), "\n")
cat("time_of_day exists:", "time_of_day" %in% names(citibike_2023_clean), "\n")
cat("bike_type exists:", "bike_type" %in% names(citibike_2023_clean), "\n")

# If the variables don't exist, add them
if (!"ride_length_min" %in% names(citibike_2023_clean)) {
  cat("\nAdding missing variables to citibike_2023_clean...\n")
  
  citibike_2023_clean <- citibike_2023_clean %>%
    mutate(
      ride_length_min = as.numeric(difftime(ended_at, started_at, units = "mins")),
      
      # Extract temporal features
      start_date = as_date(started_at),
      start_hour = hour(started_at),
      start_month = month(started_at, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
      start_day = wday(started_at, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
      start_year = year(started_at),
      
      # Create useful categories
      time_of_day = case_when(
        start_hour >= 5 & start_hour < 12 ~ "Morning",
        start_hour >= 12 & start_hour < 17 ~ "Afternoon",
        start_hour >= 17 & start_hour < 21 ~ "Evening",
        TRUE ~ "Night"
      ),
      
      bike_type = case_when(
        rideable_type == "electric_bike" ~ "Electric",
        rideable_type == "classic_bike" ~ "Classic",
        rideable_type == "docked_bike" ~ "Docked",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      
      day_type = ifelse(start_day %in% c("Saturday", "Sunday"), "Weekend", "Weekday")
    ) %>%
    # Remove unrealistic trips (if not already done)
    filter(
      ride_length_min >= 1,
      ride_length_min <= 24 * 60,
      started_at < ended_at,
      !(start_station_id == end_station_id & ride_length_min < 2)
    )
  
  cat("Variables added successfully.\n")
} else {
  cat("\nAll variables already exist in citibike_2023_clean.\n")
}

# Final check
cat(sprintf("Final NJ dataset size: %s rides\n", format(nrow(citibike_2023_clean), big.mark = ",")))
cat("Available variables:\n")
cat(paste(names(citibike_2023_clean), collapse = ", "), "\n")

```

```{r include=FALSE}

# Using our existing cleaned NJ dataset and adding NJ-specific variables
citibike_nj_analysis <- citibike_2023_clean %>%
  # Add NJ-specific variables
  mutate(
    # Create consistent member_type variable
    member_type = ifelse(member_casual == "member", "Annual Member", "Casual Rider"),
    member_type = factor(member_type, levels = c("Annual Member", "Casual Rider")),
    
    # Create clean time_of_day with proper ordering
    time_of_day = factor(time_of_day, 
                         levels = c("Morning", "Afternoon", "Evening", "Night")),
    
    # Create clean bike_type with proper ordering
    bike_type = factor(bike_type, 
                       levels = c("Classic", "Electric", "Docked", "Other")),
    
    # Add season variable for later use
    season = case_when(
      start_month %in% c("December", "January", "February") ~ "Winter",
      start_month %in% c("March", "April", "May") ~ "Spring",
      start_month %in% c("June", "July", "August") ~ "Summer",
      start_month %in% c("September", "October", "November") ~ "Fall"
    ),
    season = factor(season, levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Fall")),
    
    # Add day of week for heatmap
    day_of_week = wday(started_at, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE),
    
    # Add ride length categories for easier analysis
    ride_length_category = case_when(
      ride_length_min < 10 ~ "Short (<10 min)",
      ride_length_min < 30 ~ "Medium (10-30 min)",
      ride_length_min < 60 ~ "Long (30-60 min)",
      TRUE ~ "Very Long (>60 min)"
    ),
    ride_length_category = factor(ride_length_category,
                                  levels = c("Short (<10 min)", "Medium (10-30 min)", 
                                             "Long (30-60 min)", "Very Long (>60 min)")),
    
    # Add NJ area categories based on longitude
    nj_area = case_when(
      start_lng < -74.03 ~ "Jersey City",
      start_lng >= -74.03 ~ "Hoboken",
      TRUE ~ "Other NJ Area"
    ),
    nj_area = factor(nj_area, levels = c("Hoboken", "Jersey City", "Other NJ Area"))
  )

cat(sprintf("Total NJ City Area rides: %s\n", format(nrow(citibike_nj_analysis), big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf("Date range: %s to %s\n", 
            min(citibike_nj_analysis$start_date), 
            max(citibike_nj_analysis$start_date)))
```
